title: Public Homepage Redesign
notes: Rebuild the pre-sign-in homepage with a cleaner industrial product identity.
Reduce card clutter and decorative UI so the real Northborn workflow is the visual focus.
Add a stronger mobile navigation, simpler hero, clearer product previews and calmer responsive layout.
Keep Manager, Operator and Client views while making each role easier to understand at a glance.
Improve request-to-revenue, platform and field-work sections for faster scanning on phones.
